definition: System impulse response of the pooled stability-constrained tvNAR(1) evaluated at tau=1 (end of series): response_h = A^h s with A=(W+I)*lambda(1), s = one-standard-deviation shock to a single node, propagated linearly for H steps. State-independent by linearity, hence identical for every country; not an average. Responders are endogenous nodes plus the shocked node's own decay path. Units standardized.
